panels.heading: TODAY’S PASSAGE
panels.content:
**Proverbs 3, 8, 16, 22, 31**

This devotional is being drafted. The full reading + reflection ships in a future writing pass.

In the meantime, open your Bible to Proverbs 3, 8, 16, 22, 31 and read it slowly. Sit with one phrase that catches you. Bring it back to mind tomorrow.

panels.heading: WHY THIS PASSAGE
panels.content:
Today’s pivot: Proverbs: Daily Wisdom. The whole canon points forward — and this reading carries its own thread of that long pointing.

Christ-link: Christ wisdom personified (1 Cor 1:30).

panels.heading: A PRAYER
panels.content: Father, when I read this passage, let me see You truly. Slow my hurry. Soften my certainty. Show me what I have missed. Through Christ, who is the substance of every shadow. Amen.
